_comment: Hand-provided section code and live widget embeds applied by scripts/convert.mjs. `rules` match a GoHighLevel custom-code element by substrings of its current HTML (so desktop + mobile copies are both replaced) and swap in `file`; {{custom_values.*}} merge tags are filled from `vars`.

imageReplacements._comment: old media path -> new media path, applied to every reference (bare CDN URL, resize variants, payload). The new file and its r_320…r_1200 variants are added to the clone tree with `node scripts/image-variants.mjs <file> <mediaPath>`.

imageAlt._comment: alt text for client images that carry none, matched by media id (the id in the reference before or after replacement); translated through overrides/i18n/es.extra.json. Decorative icons (map pin, phone, clock, moon, truck, chevrons, underline, party popper, envelope, SMS) keep alt="" on purpose. Only what each image clearly shows is described (SEO audit, October 2026 — section 8c).
